title: Primary Ventral Midbrain Culture
author: Douglas Miller
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.x64frgw

steps.title: Prepare Coverslips
steps.instruction: Clean and coat coverslips for cell culture.

substeps.instruction: Boil coverslips in 1M HCl for 5 minutes, then allow to cool.
Wash 3X with ddH2O.
Wash for 30 minutes in 100% ethanol.
Wash 3X with ddH2O.
Cover flask with aluminum foil and autoclave.
Distribute 2 coverslips into each 35 x 10 mm petri dish using flamed forceps.
Dispense approximately 175 µl of 0.1 mg/ml Poly-D-Lysine on each coverslip and incubate for 1 hour at 37 °C.
Wash 3X with ddH2O and allow to air dry for at least 30 minutes.
Dilute laminin in MEM to a final concentration of 5 µg/ml and coat coverslips with 100 µl of the solution.
Cover petri dishes to prevent evaporation.

steps.title: Prepare Dissociation Media
steps.instruction: Prepare the dissociation solution fresh on the day of dissection.

substeps.instruction: Mix the following reagents in the specified order: 15.5 ml Cysteine water, 400 units papain, 4 ml DISCO, and 20 µl kynurenic acid.
Adjust pH to 7.4 using 5N HCl.
Sterile filter the solution into a Nunc vial.
Mix 25 ml Neurobasal Plus, 0.5 ml B-27 Plus, and 250 µl L-glutamine.
For day one of plating, add 40 µl GDNF (1 ng/ml) and 20 µl kynurenic acid.
Warm the media to 37 ºC.

steps.title: Prepare Dissection Station
steps.instruction: Set up the hardware and environment for tissue extraction.

substeps.instruction: Clean a 10 cm glass petri dish with 70% ethanol and allow to dry.
Glue a single Sylgard stage in the middle of the dish using VetBond and allow to cure.
Place 10 cm petri dishes on ice and fill with Gey's Balanced Salt Solution (GBSS).
Prepare a trough in ice lined with aluminum foil.

steps.title: Dissect Ventral Midbrain
steps.instruction: Isolate the ventral midbrain from post-natal day 0 pups.

substeps.instruction: Place pups on a heating pad (set to low) until ready, then place on ice in the foil-lined trough.
Once movement slows, rapidly decapitate and transfer pups to a 10 cm petri dish.
Cut skin to expose the skull and remove the skull by cutting around the base with 3 mm Vanna Scissors.
Gently push the brain from the skull into GBSS using a spatula.
Place brain on the stage, ventral surface upwards and anterior pointing left.
Pierce the brain through the rostral hypothalamus with 5A style forceps (angled downward) and pin to stage.
Make the first cut caudal to the midbrain flexure and the second cut rostral to the midbrain flexure (including caudal hypothalamus).
Orient the resulting slice with the ventral surface to the right and hold it by inserting forceps into the acqueduct.
Remove the hypothalamus by cutting the ventral portion.
Isolate the ventral midbrain by cutting approximately halfway between the previous cut and the acqueduct.
Remove left and right meninges.
Dissect ventral midbrain into 1 mm sections and transfer to dissociation media using a sterile transfer pipette.
Incubate in dissociation media for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Dissociate Tissue
steps.instruction: Mechanically dissociate the tissue into a single-cell suspension.

substeps.instruction: Warm a water bath to 37 ºC and thaw Glia Media in the bath.
Transfer dissociation media to the water bath and oxygenate with 95% O2 and 5% CO2 (flow rate ~1 bubble per second).
Transfer tissue to a 15 ml tube containing 5 ml of Glia Media, minimizing the amount of dissociation media transferred.
Wash tissue 2-3x with 10 ml Glia Media, allowing tissue to settle between washes.
Resuspend tissue in 5 ml Glia Media.
Triturate tissue 10-20X using a large bore pipette until it no longer decreases in size, then repeat with medium and small bore pipettes until the suspension is opalescent.
Centrifuge the cell suspension for 5 minutes at 1550 RPM at room temperature.
Remove supernatant, resuspend in 1 ml Glia Media, and pass through a 70 µm cell strainer.

steps.title: Plate and Transduce Neurons
steps.instruction: Count cells, plate them onto coverslips, and perform viral transduction.

substeps.instruction: Mix 10 µl of cell suspension with 10 µl Trypan Blue Solution to count live cells/µl.
Adjust cell concentration to 80,000 cells per 100 µl using Glia Media.
Pipette 100 µl of suspension directly into the laminin coating solution on each coverslip in a slow, clockwise motion.
Allow cells to settle for 2 hours in an incubator at 37 ºC with 5% CO2.
Gently flood dishes with 2 ml of Neuronal Media supplemented with GDNF and kynurenic acid.
Transduce neurons with AAV5-hSyn-GCaMP6f (30,000 genome copies per cell).

steps.title: Maintain Culture
steps.instruction: Perform regular media changes to maintain neuronal health.

substeps.instruction: Every 4 days following plating, remove 1 ml of old media and replace with 1 ml of fresh Neuronal Media (increase frequency if necessary).
Note: DIV 9-12 is the ideal window for general neuronal health and activity.
